ns2:section.sectionText: All students must enroll in this lecture section (AL1) and lab section [(AB1 (34297)] to complete registration in this course. Non-LIS graduate students and undergraduates (juniors or seniors) must have permission of instructor to enroll (mwolske@uiuc.edu). The class will meet on campus May 12-23 with possible additional lecture and lab sessions as announced by instructor. Required travel for the East St. Louis Action Research Project to be scheduled during the second two weeks (May 26-June 6). Students will coordinate with the instructor regarding their project time in East St. Louis. Contact the instructor with questions or for further details about this course (mwolske@uiuc.edu). $25 non-waived class materials fee assessed to student's tuition & fees bill.
